About Us

We are a team with more than 8 years of experience in delivering IT solutions for business process management across different industries.

ELSA is our long-term ERP SaaS platform, built with a strong focus on modern technologies, scalability, and the real operational needs of businesses.

We believe that every business is unique and requires its own specialized workflow and operational structure. That is why we develop ELSA as a platform with dedicated product editions tailored to specific industries.

ELSA Beauty Edition is a complete salon management solution designed for both independent studios and growing beauty networks. It combines appointment management, financial tracking, reporting, and AI-powered business insights in one unified system.

Our goal is simple: help beauty businesses replace operational chaos with clarity, structure, and growth.

Powerful tools for daily salon operations

Everything you need to streamline your business and focus on what matters most

Smart Calendar

Smart Appointment Calendar

Organize appointments across all masters in one unified calendar. ELSA automatically manages scheduling logic, prevents overlapping bookings, and keeps service durations consistent.

Whether you operate a single beauty studio or multiple branches, your team always has a clear real-time view of appointments, availability, and workload.

Designed for fast daily operations with minimal administrative overhead.

Reports & Analytics

Financial Reports & Business Analytics

Get a clear understanding of how your business performs every day. ELSA automatically tracks completed appointments, revenue, cancellations, and master performance — transforming operational data into actionable business insights.

Monitor revenue trends, identify your top-performing services and specialists, and make decisions based on real numbers instead of assumptions.

AI-powered summaries help simplify analytics and explain important changes in business performance.

Invoices & Payments

Payments & Professional Invoicing

Manage payments and generate professional invoices directly from completed appointments. ELSA simplifies financial workflows by connecting services, payments, and reporting into one centralized system.

Generate print-ready invoices in seconds, maintain transparent financial records, and reduce manual administrative work for your team.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is ELSA cloud-based?

Yes. ELSA works directly in your browser without installation.

Can I manage multiple masters?

Yes. ELSA supports multi-master scheduling and operational management.

Is ELSA suitable for salon networks?

Yes. ELSA Beauty Edition supports both individual salons and multi-location businesses.

Do I need technical knowledge?

No. ELSA is designed for daily business operations and is easy to use without technical setup.

Is AI included in every plan?

AI features are available in selected plans.

Can I switch from my current system to ELSA easily?

Yes. ELSA is designed for a smooth transition from spreadsheets, paper calendars, or other salon management tools, so you can start using it without disrupting your daily operations.
